headword: {申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ありません
reading: もうしわけありません
gloss: I'm very sorry; I sincerely apologize

definitions.gloss: I'm very sorry; I sincerely apologize; there is no excuse
definitions.explanation: A formal and polite expression of apology, stronger than すみません. Literally means 'there is no excuse,' conveying deep regret and acknowledgment that one's actions were inexcusable.

examples.japanese: {大変|たいへん}{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ありません。
お{待|ま}たせして{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ありません。
examples.english: I'm sorry for keeping you waiting.

examples.japanese: ご{迷惑|めいわく}をおかけして{誠|まこと}に{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ありません。{今後|こんご}このようなことがないよう{十分|じゅうぶん}{注意|ちゅうい}いたします。
examples.english: I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. I will take every care to ensure this does not happen again.

notes:
One of the most important formal apology expressions in Japanese. Literally means "there is no excuse" ({申|もう}し{訳|わけ} = excuse + ありません = does not exist). Used in business, customer service, and any situation requiring a sincere, polite apology.

FORMALITY LEVELS:
- {申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ない: casual/plain form
- {申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ありません: polite form (standard)
- {申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ございません: very polite/humble form (business, customer service)

COMMON INTENSIFIERS:
- {大変|たいへん}{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ありません: I am terribly sorry
- {誠|まこと}に{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ありません: I am sincerely sorry (very formal)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- すみません: sorry/excuse me — lighter, everyday apology; also used to get attention
- ごめんなさい: I'm sorry — more personal and informal; used between friends and family
- {失礼|しつれい}しました: excuse me (for what I did) — used for minor social infractions
